nodes.name: model_spec_loading_and_sizing
nodes.description: Loads serialized model data and exposes structural sizing metadata for downstream computation.
nodes.conceptual_summary: SerializedStructureIngestionAndComplexityRatioExtraction. Reads a serialized structured artifact from a valid filesystem path and deserializes it into a typed in-memory specification for computation. It then derives a normalized structural complexity metric by computing the ratio between discrete state cardinality and representational dimensionality. The operation maps persistent encoded data into both an executable structural object and a scalar size invariant.. Applications: Finite-element engineering: load a serialized solver/mesh specification and compute state-variable density per geometric dimension., Robotics autonomy: ingest a serialized transition-system model and compute state-cardinality per latent-coordinate dimension., Computational biology: parse a serialized hidden-state model and compute hidden-state count per observation-space dimension., Network science: load a serialized dynamical graph-process specification and compute process-state count per embedding dimension.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function loads kinematic parameters from a file and computes total reach in linear time and space relative to the link count N.

nodes.name: KinematicGoalFeasibility
nodes.description: Computes inverse-kinematic feasibility and goal-distance metrics for desired end-effector targets and initial state construction.
nodes.type_signature: (angles_desired: array-like, position_desired: array-like, x: array-like, position_current: array-like, position_goal: array-like) -> tuple[array-like, array-like, float]
nodes.conceptual_summary: Constraint-Manifold Projection and Target Discrepancy Evaluation. Maps a target in observation space to a candidate in latent state space using an inverse constraint solver, while also projecting an initial latent-state guess onto a feasible constraint manifold. In parallel, computes a non-negative squared Euclidean discrepancy between a current observation vector and a goal observation vector. The result is a feasibility-adjusted initialization, an inverse-mapped candidate state, and a scalar objective component for downstream optimization or ranking.. Applications: Computational chemistry: project a molecular conformation seed onto valid geometric constraints and infer a conformation that matches target descriptor coordinates., Computer graphics/animation: recover rig control parameters that produce a target marker layout while tracking squared discrepancy to a desired pose trajectory., Medical imaging: estimate latent deformation parameters that align anatomy landmarks to target coordinates and compute residual alignment error., Wireless localization: infer latent source/environment parameters from desired measurement-space targets and evaluate squared position mismatch to a navigation goal.

nodes.name: ComputeGoalDistanceMetric
nodes.description: Validate current/goal positions as 2D vectors, compute Cartesian error, and return squared Euclidean goal distance.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function calculates the squared Euclidean distance between two workspace positions in constant time and space.

nodes.type_signature: (angles_desired: array-like, link_lengths: array-like, state_dim_ratio: integer) -> array-like
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function constructs the state vector by copying the desired N joint angles in linear time and space.

nodes.name: ComputeIKTargetError
nodes.description: Compute Cartesian error between desired target position and current end-effector position for IK correction.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computing the workspace position error is a simple vector subtraction in the constant-dimension 2D workspace.

nodes.name: AssemblePositionJacobian
nodes.description: Construct the 2xDOF position Jacobian from current chain state and link lengths by accumulating each joint’s positional influence.
nodes.type_signature: (x: array-like, link_lengths: array-like, dof: integer, state_dim_ratio: integer) -> tuple[matrix-like, array-like]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Constructing the 2 x N workspace Jacobian matrix for the kinematic chain requires O(N) partial derivative evaluations.

nodes.name: SolveLeastSquaresJointUpdate
nodes.description: Compute pseudo-inverse of the position Jacobian and map Cartesian error into joint-angle update space.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Solving the underdetermined linear system for a 2 x N Jacobian matrix takes O(N) time and space using pseudoinverse or standard solvers.

nodes.name: DynamicsAndLinearizationKernel
nodes.description: Evaluates continuous-time state derivatives and local Jacobian linearization of system dynamics.
nodes.type_signature: (x: array-like, u: array-like, _t: float) -> tuple[array-like, matrix]
nodes.conceptual_summary: Local Flow and Sensitivity Linearization Operator. Given a point in a continuous state space, a concurrent conditioning vector, and a scalar index, this operation evaluates the instantaneous velocity field at that point. It then computes the first-order Jacobian of that velocity map to produce a tangent-space linear approximation of nearby evolution. The pair captures both immediate directional change and local sensitivity of that change to perturbations.. Applications: Perturbation and stability analysis of biochemical reaction-network kinetics, Small-signal linearization of electromechanical grid and converter dynamics, Local forecast-sensitivity operators for geophysical fluid data assimilation, Real-time tangent models for deformable-body simulation and control in graphics/robotics

nodes.description: Synthesizes control action from current state and derivative information.

outputs.name: u_cmd
outputs.constraints: control command compatible with dynamics input

nodes.conceptual_summary: State-Tangent-to-Input Projection. Computes a vector-valued input by applying a synthesis map to an instantaneous state vector, its first-order time derivative estimate, and a scalar temporal coordinate. The transform converts local phase-space information (position in state space plus tangent direction) into an admissible excitation vector for the governed dynamics. This is a causal per-step feedback projection that may be linear or nonlinear and may vary with time.. Applications: Trajectory stabilization in autonomous aerial navigation using state and rate estimates, Infusion-rate computation in physiological regulation models from concentration states and slopes, Coil-current command synthesis in electromagnetic plasma-shaping systems, Thermal actuator drive generation in semiconductor process chambers from temperature fields and gradients
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Synthesizing the PD control commands involves element-wise scalar multiplications and subtractions on N-dimensional state vectors in linear time and space.
